name: billing-invoice-bugfix
instruction:
The billing library in /app/billing has failing unit tests. Run the suite from /app with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`, find the bugs in the library code, and fix them so that every test passes.

Requirements:
- Do not modify anything under /app/tests.
- Pages returned by `paginate` are 1-based: page 1 holds the first `per_page` items.
- The bulk discount (10% of the line subtotal) applies to lines with a quantity of 10 units or more.
- Keep the public function names and signatures in billing/invoice.py unchanged.
